sheets.cover_title: MAIN KITCHEN + BREAKFAST · WALL PANELS, BACKING FRAMES, CLIPS, WINDOW / NICHE TRIM, DOORS DK1 DK2
questions: Kitchen to Butler's doors DK1 and DK2: please confirm that both doors open INTO the Butler's pantry (push from the kitchen side, flush with the wall panels; pull from the Butler's side, G180 integrated handle on the Butler's side), concealed soft self-closing hinges toward the hood niche - DK1 hinged on its right and DK2 on its left as seen from the kitchen. Your note reads "left handed from kitchen - right handed"; please state which handing standard you use.

Openings per UCON survey: DK1 960 x 2819 mm, DK2 998.5 x 2819 mm from the subfloor (your drawing: 988 x 2750 for both). Please build both doors to our openings with your profile and technical gaps head 9, sides 4.3: frame 951.4 x 2810 / 989.9 x 2810, leaf cladding 849 x 2660.85 / 887.5 x 2660.85, 10 mm above the finished floor, top at the panel seam 2728. Please confirm.

Doors flush with our wall panels: backing frame 19 + clip gap 3.3 + panel 22 = finished face 44.3 mm from the wall (your detail 1:2 shows 42.5). Wall 172 mm: please confirm a jamb depth of 203.8 mm for both doors. The panels next to the frames are rebated 10 mm at the back where they pass in front of the frame - please confirm the frame face position so that the rebate has clearance.
DK2 plan section shows wall 152 and jamb 212, while the vertical section shows 170. Our survey: 172 for both doors. Please update.

Our levels (UCON survey from the subfloor): finished floor +2-1/4" (57.15 mm, to be verified on site); stone plinth by others 8" (203.2 mm) above the finished floor, top at 260.35 mm above the subfloor; our wall panels start on the plinth. Your drawing shows the panels starting 214 mm [8 7/16"] above the floor line. Please revise the panel heights to our levels (door frames stand on the finished floor, door leaf 10 mm above it).

Please confirm the maximum panel size you can produce in lacquered MDF 22 (we assumed 2800 x 2070 mm, max column width 1220 mm). Our panels are up to 2467.65 mm high and 849 mm wide; the long horizontal strips under and over the windows are up to 2419 mm long. Painted panels may be rotated (no grain match).

UCON proposal for all window reveals (W1, W2, A, B - sides, head and sill the same): the wall panels stop 13 mm over the opening edge; a lacquered MDF 6 L-liner, 4 pieces per window mitred 45 deg, stands on the 3rd step of the window trim (64 mm deep) with a 10 mm shadow to the panel edge; its flange runs behind the panel in a slot formed by two MDF 6 strips glued to the panel back by the factory: B 6 x 34 and A 6 x 17. Under the wide windows W2 / A the sill strip (84.65 / 86.65 high) is glued, no clips. Can you make the liners and glue the strips? Please comment or propose your detail.

Stone plinth by others: 20 mm thick, face flush with our panel face (44.3 mm from the wall), top at 260.35 mm above the subfloor, with a 10 x 10 mm notch along its top front edge (shadow line under the panels). The panels stand on the stone; no groove in the panel is needed. Please confirm the panel bottom edge.

Niche stone per your drawing 251161 rev 3: 3315 wide, 3067 high above the finished floor, worktop 700 deep. UCON survey of the niche: 3314 wide, 3067.85 above the finished floor, 660 deep. Please make the niche stone (back cladding, worktop, bases) max 3310 wide (2 mm clearance each side); the worktop projects about 40 mm past the wall face. Our MDF liner runs around the niche in line with the niche walls - it does not narrow the niche. Please confirm.

Mitred panels (45 deg external corners): on the D-sheets the X of the clip recesses is measured from the long point of the mitre at the panel face, as seen from the back. Please confirm that this reference suits your CNC, or tell us which reference you prefer.
sheets.questions_note: Red number = open question, marked with the same red bubble on the sheet it belongs to. Q6 (stone window sills) is withdrawn - there are no stone sills. Please answer in the ANSWER column or by e-mail quoting the number. The drawings are reissued once all questions are answered.

G-001: Survey by UCON. All dimensions in mm. Z from the top of the subfloor (survey zero); finished floor FFL +57.15 (2-1/4") to be verified on site (Q5).
Wall panels MDF 22, finish per TM, joints 10. Panel face 44.3 from the wall = backing frame 19 + clip gap 3.3 + panel 22. Panels numbered P01..P43, per wall left to right as seen from the room.

Backing frames: plywood 3/4", made, drilled and fixed by UCON (A-20x, A-702, A-703). Clips Fastmount VL-03H, recess mount, 266 pcs: panel recesses D25 x 7 by the factory per the D-sheets (BACK VIEW), frame holes D25 x 8 by UCON CNC.
Stone plinth by others, 20 thick, face flush with the panels, notch 10 x 10 at the top front edge (Q9, A-512).
Windows W1 / W2 / A / B: MDF 6 L-liner and strips B / A on the panel back - UCON proposal (Q8, A-511). Niche: liner in line with the niche walls, niche stone by others (Q10).
Doors DK1 / DK2: TM concealed doors, profile as D01, flush with the panels, to our openings (Q1-Q4, A-501..A-504).
Window heads and the Wall 2 soffit to be checked by laser on site before the panels are released for production.
Red marks are open questions or TBD items. Not for production until G-002 is answered and the set is reissued.
